_comment: NET-NEW wire shape (C5, C6): GET /api/v1/transfer-targets/queues, the agent-readable queue picker behind the digital and voice transfer dialogs (transfer-dialog.tsx:33, voice-transfer-dialog.tsx:45 read today's AdminOnly GET /admin/queues and get a silent 403 -> []). Group `/transfer-targets` is mapped inside ConversationEndpoints.MapConversationEndpoints with RequireAuthorization("Permission:contacts:conversation:transfer") + RequireOperationalTenant(). Query: `search` (optional; case-insensitive substring on name; absent = all), `page` (default 1), `pageSize` (default 100, clamped to 1..200). Body: the EXISTING generic PagedResult<T> (Verbara.Platform.Core/PagedResult.cs) of the NEW sealed record TransferTargetQueueDto(string Id, string Name), generated as PagedResultOfTransferTargetQueueDto / TransferTargetQueueDto in openapi.d.ts. Only queues with IsActive = true, ordered by name (ordinal, case-insensitive). totalCount counts the matching ACTIVE queues. NOT QueueDto (AdminEndpoints.cs:1300: SLA, overflow, wrap-up are admin data). The Web gets a NEW hook with its own queryKey (never ['queues']: use-queues.ts:15 is shared by ~30 admin files) that imports the generated types. `id` is also the `target` of POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/voice-transfer with `kind` `queue` (fixtures/voice-transfer.v1.json): one id for the digital targetQueueId and the voice target. Every child change's delta spec must cite these field names VERBATIM (verbatim-fixture-citation rule, /xr:propagate).
